# Assembly101 benchmarks

Results are comparable only within the same protocol section. A code link is not an independent reproduction.

## ICIP 2023 Assembly101 validation, all-view fused anticipation

<a id="assembly101-icip2023-val-multiview"></a>

**Task:** `action_anticipation` (original: Action anticipation)  
**Dataset release:** `v1` · **Annotation version:** `author-release-unspecified`  
**Target:** `future_assembly_action` · **Split:** Official train.csv to validation_challenge.csv

### Comparison setting

| Dimension | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sample selection | Fine-grained anticipation annotations; predictions from all fixed and egocentric views of each sequence are average-pooled into one video-level prediction. Overall validation subset. |
| Inputs | rgb; Visual features before the next fine-grained action; goal labels are training supervision for goal-branch variants, not future labels supplied at inference. |
| Representation | 2048-dimensional per-frame TSM RGB features, using all fixed and egocentric views. |
| Observation window | variable seconds (Past observations aggregated by TempAgg; the cited cohort does not report one fixed duration for every clip.) |
| Anticipation gap | 1 seconds (next action onset) |
| Prediction horizon | 1 actions (next annotated fine-grained action) |
| Training policy | external_data: allowed, pretraining: allowed, extra_supervision: allowed, ensemble: allowed |
| Evaluation | Class-mean top-5 recall on the overall Assembly101 validation set after all-view score averaging.; Mean recall across classes; multi-view scores average-pooled per video. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Definition | Direction | Unit | Subset | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action_recall_at_5` | Mean top-five recall across fine-grained verb-object action classes. | higher | percent | overall validation | [goal_paper](https://gall.cv-uni-bonn.de/download/jgall_latentanticipation_icip23.pdf), [official_code](https://github.com/assembly-101/assembly101-action-anticipation/tree/main/tempAgg-action-anticipation) |
| `object_recall_at_5` | Mean top-five recall across anticipated object classes. | higher | percent | overall validation | [goal_paper](https://gall.cv-uni-bonn.de/download/jgall_latentanticipation_icip23.pdf), [official_code](https://github.com/assembly-101/assembly101-action-anticipation/tree/main/tempAgg-action-anticipation) |
| `verb_recall_at_5` | Mean top-five recall across anticipated verb classes. | higher | percent | overall validation | [goal_paper](https://gall.cv-uni-bonn.de/download/jgall_latentanticipation_icip23.pdf), [official_code](https://github.com/assembly-101/assembly101-action-anticipation/tree/main/tempAgg-action-anticipation) |

### Best verified results found in recorded snapshots

**Best verified paper-reported result found — checked 2026-10-08.** Four configurations from ICIP 2023 Table 1 multi-view validation cohort. The official test split and later papers are outside this snapshot; best here is not a current field-wide SOTA claim.
